title: Yummy Crispy Canadian Chicken Casserole
description: A comforting Canadian chicken casserole with a crisp gelatin glaze, spherified chicken bites, and a fondue-pot twist, perfect for a quick, paleo-friendly dinner.
instructions: Toss the chicken cubes, cauliflower florets, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, maple syrup, and coconut oil in a bowl until evenly coated.
Spread the mixture on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes until golden and cooked through.
In a separate bowl, dissolve the gelatin powder in 2 cups of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to set.
Prepare a 200 ml calcium chloride solution and, using a syringe, drop small amounts of the chicken into the solution to form spheres; let them set for 2 minutes before rinsing in cold water.
Transfer the baked chicken mixture into a fondue pot and pour the cooled gelatin over the top, forming a crispy glaze as it sets.
Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes to allow the gelatin to firm into a crisp crust.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley before serving hot.
